name: code-ontology-companion
description: Apply source-backed code exploration to your current task. Search authorized Java/Spring and Python code, trace static dependencies, and explore snapshots in an offline 3D workbench.

interface.longDescription: Apply Code Ontology Companion to the current conversation: reuse an authorized workspace, check freshness, and start a relevant symbol search or static impact lookup. Prefer actually exposed local MCP tools, with a verified bundled CLI fallback. After meaningful supported source changes, refresh within the authorized scope and report coverage and warnings. Optional Context and Contracts workflows are selected only when runnable and keep their own approval and evidence boundaries. Explore structure, impact, and snapshot changes in an offline 3D workbench with keyboard and text alternatives. Deterministic analysis does not execute target code or make network requests. Static relationships do not establish runtime behavior or current authorization. Inspect rule-attributed relationship evidence and adapter coverage. Optional separately authorized local Ollama inference stays outside observed evidence.
capabilities: Current-conversation application with an actual first lookup
Capability-aware routing and authorized change checkpoints
Offline 3D structure, impact, and changes workbench
Exact symbol search and pinned snapshot reads
Directional static dependency paths with source evidence
Auditable relationship evidence and adapter coverage
Selected portable code references and RDF export
defaultPrompt: Apply Code Ontology Companion to this project and use it to help with my current task.
If I change OrderService, what code may be affected? Show static evidence and runtime limitations.
Use the ontology products available here for this task, starting with a real lookup or selected-artifact check.
